descriptions.dial_drag: Dial feels rough or drags when turning
descriptions.dial_loose: Dial has excessive play or wobble
descriptions.combo_drift: Combination stopped working — numbers may have drifted
descriptions.handle_pressure: Handle is hard to turn or requires excessive force
descriptions.handle_slipping: Handle spins freely without engaging bolts
descriptions.handle_screw_loose: Handle spins freely even before entering code — loose setscrew
descriptions.lockout_mode_active: Keypad temporarily locked after multiple wrong entries
descriptions.deactivated_codes: Previously working access code no longer works
descriptions.door_drag: Door drags or rubs when opening/closing
descriptions.bolt_binding: Bolts won't retract — binding in bolt holes
descriptions.overstuffed_safe: Safe is overstuffed — items blocking bolt retraction
descriptions.broken_linkage: Handle turns but bolts don't retract — broken linkage inside door
descriptions.no_spin_change: Dial spins but safe won't open — internal lock issue
descriptions.key_wont_turn: Key won't turn in the lock cylinder
descriptions.key_jamming: Key inserted but won't come out
descriptions.relocker_tripped: Relocker activated — safe fell or was struck
descriptions.motor_weak: Lock motor sounds weak or slow
descriptions.compromised_wiring: Keypad cable loose, frayed, or disconnected
